When you have window tint applied to your home’s windows it’s natural to want to make sure it stands the test of time… so how long does home window tint last? Below is information on how long does house tint last and what factors can impact how long a home window tint lasts.

If you’re considering having window tint applied to your home’s windows and want to know how long home window tint lasts, here is what you need to know:

How Long Does Home Window Tint Last
And How To Choose The Right Tint For Your Home

How long house tint lasts does vary but on average window film lasts around 15 years, however, there are a few different factors that can impact how long home window tint lasts:

Quality Of The Window Film

To get the most out of your investment and maintain the value of your home you must choose a high-quality film. Poor-quality films may be cheaper but they will cost you in the long run. They will show signs of wear and tear quickly and may not adhere to your windows properly. This can bring down the value of your home, look unsightly and you’ll need to replace the film in a much shorter time.

Installation

The quality of the film won’t make a difference if the film has not been applied correctly. Ensure your window film is applied by experienced professionals. This will ensure the window film lasts longer and won’t compromise the appearance of your home.

Cleaning

When cleaning your windows, avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive methods as this can also affect how long home window tint lasts.

Warranty

Another factor to take into consideration when choosing a window tint for your home is whether or not it is covered under warranty. At Tint a Home, most of our home window tints come with a Lifetime Warranty and all residential applications have a lifetime warranty – giving you absolute peace of mind that your film will last and last. We also only ever use the best window films that are Government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality that is installed by a highly trained professional team of installers.
